caption: A pot of boiling water is flung into the air on a day far below freezing, and the spray turns into a cloud of ice crystals and vapour that drifts away instead of falling as water.

sa.check: A pot of boiling water is flung into the air.
The arc of water breaks into a white cloud.
Little or no liquid water reaches the ground.
The setting reads as far below freezing: snow, ice or heavy winter clothing.
The fling comes first and the cloud follows.

pc.expect: The water leaves the pot as an arc and breaks into a cloud of fine crystals and vapour rather than staying a stream of drops.
pc.fail: The arc stays a solid sheet of water all the way to the ground; or the water lands as a puddle and stays liquid; or the cloud sets into a single sheet of ice in the air; or the water freezes into one solid lump in flight.

pc.expect: The cloud drifts and spreads with the air rather than falling as water, and what does fall settles as frost or snow.
pc.fail: The cloud falls straight down as a stream of water and splashes; or the cloud rises steadily and keeps climbing out of view; or the cloud hangs as a fixed shape without drifting; or water rises from the ground back into the cloud.

pc.expect: The cloud only spreads and thins and does not gather back into a stream.
pc.fail: The cloud gathers back into a stream and returns to the pot; or the cloud thickens steadily after the fling; or the crystals melt into liquid in the freezing air and pool; or the cloud spreads and then draws in again.

pc.expect: The water leaves the pot along the arm's swing, follows an arc, and the cloud carries on in that direction as it spreads.
pc.fail: The water leaves the pot against the swing; or the cloud stops dead at the top of the arc; or the cloud reverses and returns along the arc; or the arc bends sideways with no sign of wind.

pc.expect: One pot of water; the cloud is the water that was flung and none appears from nowhere.
pc.fail: A second cloud appears away from the arc; or the cloud vanishes at a stroke while still thick; or the pot refills itself; or water appears in the air far from the arc.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot, the clothing and the snowy surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the clothing changes colour; or the ground's snow changes texture between frames.

note: Whoever flings the pot is kept because the throw is the caption's action; their form is not judged.
